<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import os

# Read input
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'

# Read the input data
data = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Get the indicator columns (excluding city_id, city_name, year)
indicators = data.columns[1:-1]  # DE1001V, DE1002V, DE3001V, DE3017V, TT1003V, TT1006V, TT1007V, TT1010V

# Count missing values per indicator
missing_counts = data.isnull().sum()

# Calculate missing rates
missing_rates = missing_counts / len(data)

# Create missingness report
report = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicators,
    'missing_count': missing_counts,
    'missing_rate': missing_rates,
    'kept': (missing_rates <= 0.30).astype(str)
})

# Save missingness report
report.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Create selected matrix
selected_data = data.copy()
selected_data['indicator'] = indicators
selected_data['missing_rate'] = missing_rates

# Filter to keep only indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
selected_data = selected_data[selected_data['missing_rate'] <= 0.30]

# Save selected matrix
selected_data.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
